scope: Podunk Mick npc21 walks inside his wander radius, faces the player in the view circle, and speaks woof, woof_secret, woof_deal, woof_treats and woof_animals. Cutscene Area11 runs mick_bark and steps the player 16px north until gave_treats. Field-enter RNG replays reviewed _ready draws and screen-entered draws without spawning enemies. Telepathy, the heart emote, other NPC dialogue and movement, music and field battles stay deferred.

localized.en:
Woof woof!
(Grrr, my butt is so itchy!)
(Stop standing there and lend me a hand!)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
汪汪！
（呃——，我的屁股好痒啊！）
（别光站在那儿，快帮我一把！）

localized.en:
(Ahhh, many thanks.)
(Wait a minute, you can understand me?)
(You must have learned Telepathy!)
(That's great and all, but don't you dare use it on me by pressing [ui_select] and selecting it within the PSI menu.)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
（啊啊啊，感激不尽。）
（等一下，你能听懂我说话？）
（你一定是学会了心灵感应吧！）
（那倒是挺厉害的，不过你可别通过按[ui_select]并在PSI菜单里选择它来对我使用哦。）

localized.en: (And don't even think of using it by simply holding down [ui_toggle] and pressing [ui_accept].)
localized.zh_Hans_CN: （而且，按住[ui_toggle]后再按下[ui_accept]来使用这个能力的念头更是想都别想。）

localized.en:
Woof woof!
(Don't you dare use Telepathy on me by pressing [ui_select] and selecting it within the PSI menu.)
(And don't even think of using it by simply holding down [ui_toggle] and pressing [ui_accept].)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
汪汪！
（你可别通过按[ui_select]并在PSI菜单里选择它来对我使用心灵感应哦。）
（而且，按住[ui_toggle]后再按下[ui_accept]来使用这个能力的念头更是想都别想。）

localized.en:
(I can smell some Dog Treats in the basement.)
(If you fetch them for me, I'll let you go.)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
（我闻到地下室里有一些狗狗零食的味道。）
（你要是帮我把它们拿来，我就放你过去哦。）

localized.en:
Woof!
(Woah, are those Dog Treats? Give them to me!)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
汪！
（哇，那是狗狗零食？快把它们给我！）
（这件事要对所有人都要保密哦。）

localized.en:
Woof woof!
(If you see any other animals, try listening to their thoughts.)
localized.zh_Hans_CN:
汪汪！
（要是见到了其他动物，也试着听听它们的想法吧。）

localized.en: Looks like Mick has something to tell you.
localized.zh_Hans_CN: 看样子米克有事情和你说。
